Full summary: Reporter review round fixed (all 7 confirmed findings): root containment for ../ scopes, root-equivalent skip, ENOENT/unreadable split, provisional inclusion, no-silent-no-op error field, comment restored, mutation-strength pins. 1613 green. Shipping 2.12.0.
Decisions: Chose resolved-path containment (must start with projectRoot+sep) with a reported scope_outside_root bucket over rejecting ../ scopes at write time — field stores already hold messy scope strings; the reporter must be safe against existing data, and root-equivalent resolutions join the skipped_project_scope bucket the honesty skip exists for; Chose to include provisional decisions in the scan — the field runs provisional as its ratification queue, and an empty-list provisional deserves candidates exactly as much as an active one
Findings: Fourth consecutive review round with confirmed majors in reviewed code (../ escape walking sibling directories; the wall-3 overlap filter surviving mutation) — the reviewer also mutation-tested in a scratchpad copy without touching the live tree, exactly the worktree-isolation discipline the memory prescribes
